Sir,

Please refer to Head Office letters of even number dated 31.3.10 &
19.08.10 vide which it was directed that all pending proposals and clarifications
should be expedited and submitted to Head Office in a time bound manner.

It is regretted to note that despite repeated reminders a large number of
proposals are still pending for grant of exemption due to non-submission. of the
requisite clarifications / documents by the concerned offices.

The list of pending cases with details of Head Office reference and
reminders are enclosed. These details show that many cases are pending for
more than a year due to non submission of proper replies. You are, therefore,
requested to ensure that the requisite replies / documents is submitted to Head
Office by 30.41.10 alongwith specific remarks / recommendations of the officer-
in-charge in respect of each case.

| You must be aware that as per the amendment in the Income Tax Act, for
obtaining the status of a recognized Provident Fund exemption u/s 17 has to be
granted to the establishment by the Appropriate Government latest by 31.12.10
and therefore It is our responsibility to ensure that all eligible cases are
processed and submitted to the Appropriate Government. You are therefore
requested to ensure that no eligible case is kept pending.

It must also be ensured that in cases involving incomplete proposals and
violations of conditions of exemption, the relaxation order is withdrawn and such
cases are also forwarded with recommendations for rejection of the exemption
application by the Appropriate Government. A consolidated reply in respect of the
pending exemption cases pertaining to all the offices under your jurisdiction may
also be submitted to this office by 30.11.10.

CPFC has expressed his extreme displeasure on the above issue and has
directed that the explanation of the concerned officers responsible for
delay be called for by the Additional Central PF Commissioners (Zones\

and necessary disciplinary action be initiated if satisfactory reply is not
submitted by the APFCs / RPFCs.

Encl: As above

Yours faithfully,

oyayte
(K. C. Pandey)
Addl. Central PF Commissioner (Compliance)
